def modify_binning(self, bin_number: int, bin_selection: str, 
                     bin_name: str='', is_high_pt: bool=False):
    '''Modifies the definition of a bin
    
    Args:
      bin_number: bin number to modify
      bin_selection: new selection for bin, empty string reuses selection
      bin_name: new name for bin, empty string reuses name
      is_high_pt: indicates if bin is high pt
    '''
    if bin_selection != '':
      self.data_nom_tnp_analyzer.bin_selections[bin_number] = bin_selection
      self.data_altsig_tnp_analyzer.bin_selections[bin_number] = bin_selection
      self.data_altbkg_tnp_analyzer.bin_selections[bin_number] = bin_selection
      self.data_altsigbkg_tnp_analyzer.bin_selections[bin_number] = (
          bin_selection)
      self.mc_nom_tnp_analyzer.bin_selections[bin_number] = bin_selection
      self.mc_alt_tnp_analyzer.bin_selections[bin_number] = bin_selection
    if bin_name != '':
      self.data_nom_tnp_analyzer.bin_names[bin_number] = bin_name
      self.data_altsig_tnp_analyzer.bin_names[bin_number] = bin_name
      self.data_altbkg_tnp_analyzer.bin_names[bin_number] = bin_name
      self.data_altsigbkg_tnp_analyzer.bin_names[bin_number] = (
          bin_name)
      self.mc_nom_tnp_analyzer.bin_names[bin_number] = bin_name
      self.mc_alt_tnp_analyzer.bin_names[bin_number] = bin_name
    if (is_high_pt and not (bin_number in self.highpt_bins)):
      self.highpt_bins.append(bin_number)
    elif (not is_high_pt and (bin_number in self.highpt_bins)):
      self.highpt_bins.remove(bin_number)
